Author: Boujee Becky
Name: Logoria
Punchline: Eureka Logos Action dex, farming planner, and one-click Logos Manipulator auto-fill.
Description: A collection log for all 56 Eureka Logos Actions. Syncs automatically from Drake's in-game Logos Action Log, so your dex fills itself with no manual ticking. Reads your live mneme stock at the Logos Manipulator and highlights every action you can synthesise but have never made. One click loads a combination into the Astral Array, stopping short of the synthesis itself so nothing is ever consumed without your say-so. The farming planner totals mnemes across everything you are working toward and groups them by the logogram that yields them, with map pins for where to farm. Includes a visual collection log, a pinnable overlay tracker, and ten UI themes.
Changelog: v1.0.0 - Initial release. Per-character dex for all 56 Logos Actions, automatic sync from Drake's Logos Action Log, live mneme stock at the Manipulator, ready-to-synthesise highlighting, farming planner with grouped shopping list and map pins, visual collection log, pinnable overlay tracker, ten themes plus a vanilla mode.
